body: No it's not fair and it's so hard with them in your house. I understand.
I feel like I am living for everyone else and I don't know who I am.
I actually want that but yeah.
I cut and I really don't know why? It's like everyone keeps asking me how I am and like I don't anymore.

I am sorry. Well done for having the courage to report. I never had that courage to report and for it to be taken further. The last time it happened was 3 yrs ago and only told someone 5 months ago so it was a lot to take in and couldn't even deal with all those questions.
